port._doc: The HTTP server listens on this port

config-path._doc: the path to the service log config file

config-path-worker._doc: the path to the cluster worker service log config file

enabled._doc: toggles logging of v8 GC events

heartbeat-path._doc: Physical path of the file served by the service to indicate its health to the load balancer

count._doc: The number of workers to create in the multi-process cluster. 0 indicates no workers are created and all requests are handled by the main process. -1 creates workers equivalent to the number of CPUs on the local host

execArgv._doc: list of string arguments passed to each worker

base-path._doc: the base path to which sigsegv crash dumps are written
